struct@(A,B) Foo {
  first: Bar@(A,B);
  second: Bar@(B,A);
}

struct@(X,Y) Bar {
  num: Int@X;
  logic: Bool@Y;
}

func@(P,Q) foo() {
  let x: Int@P = 10;
  let y: Int@Q = 20;

  let nested: Foo@(P,Q) = Foo@(P,Q) {
    first: Bar@(P,Q) {
      num: x,
      logic: true
    },
    second: Bar@(Q,P) {
      num: y,
      logic: false
    }
  };
}
---
(source-file
  (struct
    (role-type
      (role A)
      (role B)) Foo
    (struct-body
      (struct-field first
        (named-type Bar@
          (role-type
            (role A)
            (role B))))
      (struct-field second
        (named-type Bar@
          (role-type
            (role B)
            (role A))))))
  (struct
    (role-type
      (role X)
      (role Y)) Bar
    (struct-body
      (struct-field num
        (named-type Int@
          (role-type
            (role X))))
      (struct-field logic
        (named-type Bool@
          (role-type
            (role Y))))))
  (func
    (func-sig
      (role-type
        (role P)
        (role Q)) foo
      (params))
    (scope "{"
      (let x
        (type
          (named-type Int@
            (role-type
              (role P))))
        (int 10) ";")
      (let y
        (type
          (named-type Int@
            (role-type
              (role Q))))
        (int 20) ";")
      (let nested
        (type
          (named-type Foo@
            (role-type
              (role P)
              (role Q))))
        (struct-expr Foo@
          (role-type
            (role P)
            (role Q))
          (field-init first
            (struct-expr Bar@
              (role-type
                (role P)
                (role Q))
              (field-init num x)
              (field-init logic
                (bool true)) "}"))
          (field-init second
            (struct-expr Bar@
              (role-type
                (role Q)
                (role P))
              (field-init num y)
              (field-init logic
                (bool false)) "}")) "}") ";") "}")))
